newsitem.title: USA: CME to beam Greenspan testimony to trading pits.
newsitem.headline: CME to beam Greenspan testimony to trading pits.

text.p: The Chicago Mercantile Exchange will broadcast Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan's Humphrey-Hawkins testimony to its trading pits Tuesday.
Four large screens -- two on the upper and two on the lower CME trading floors -- will broadcast close-captioned video of the Congressional testimony, a CME official said.
With their own hand-held radios, floor traders will be able to tune into the audio of the Fed chief's key testimony, as well.
"It's an experiment just to see if it helps our traders get access to breaking news," said CME spokesman Ellen Resnick.
"It's something we've had in mind since we put in the screens" in January 1996, Resnick said.
So far, the four huge screens have shown video of visiting dignitaries and charts of CME products.
